msg: 开始调研「AI 会议纪要」的 3 个产品…
Otter.ai：读取 40 个页面，记录 12469 字
Granola：读取 33 个页面，记录 11050 字
Fathom：读取 34 个页面，记录 6885 字
Fathom：⛔ 拦截 2 个来源对不上的字段（判定为编造，已降级为未获取）

positioning.value: Otter.ai is the creator of the leading AI meeting agent, providing real-time notes, voice-activated agents that participate in meetings, summaries, action items, customized insights and content.

target_user.value: Over 25 million global users spanning individuals, teams, startups, and Fortune 500 companies.

core_capability.value: OtterPilot can record audio, take notes, and answer questions during meetings in real time, even if you aren’t there.

free_tier.value: You get 300 free minutes per month and a maximum recording time of 30 minutes. Free users can upload just three prerecorded audio or video files per lifetime.

start_price.value: Pro plan costs $8.33/month (annual billing) or $16.99/month (monthly billing).

price_model.value: Subscription-capped pricing with per-user per-month or per-year billing; Pro and Business are per user, Enterprise is custom pricing.

key_limit.value: Pro: 1,200 minutes per month, 90-minute per-conversation limit, 10 prerecorded uploads per month. Business: 6,000 minutes per month, 4-hour per-conversation limit.

deployment.value: Web, mobile (Android/iOS), API, and Chrome Extension.

data_policy.value: Otter trains proprietary models on de-identified user data with no opt-out; automatic training using encrypted, de-identified data.

positioning.value: AI-powered notepad for meetings; helps people in back-to-back meetings capture notes and get things done. You jot rough details, Granola transcribes in the background and enhances notes with AI.

target_user.value: Founders, leaders, and partners at top VC firms; product and sales teams; individuals and small teams on Business, larger companies on Enterprise. Over half of users are in leadership roles.

core_capability.value: On-device audio capture (not a meeting bot), real-time transcription with immediate audio deletion, manual note-taking plus AI enhancement (AI additions appear in gray), cross-meeting search and Q&A, templates/recipes, and integrations such as Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Attio, Affinity, Zapier, and MCP.

free_tier.value: Free Basic plan includes unlimited meetings, AI chat within and across meetings, shared folders, customized templates, and multi-language support; note history limited to 14/30 days depending on source; excludes advanced integrations, advanced AI thinking models, and centralized billing/user management.

start_price.value: Business: $14 per user per month; Enterprise: $35 per user per month (from $35/user/month).

price_model.value: Per-seat billing, not per meeting or storage gigabyte; flat monthly fee per active user, bill adjusts automatically when members join or leave. No hidden fees, no per-meeting charges, no pay-per-minute transcription. Annual contracts or volume pricing via sales team.

key_limit.value: Free plan meeting history retention is disputed: 14 days vs 30 days vs older than 30 days requiring upgrade, depending on official source. Free plan excludes advanced integrations (Slack, Zapier, Notion, HubSpot, Affinity, Attio), advanced AI thinking models, and centralized billing/user management. Paid plans have unlimited meeting history and no daily transcription limit.

deployment.value: Desktop/mobile local app, not a meeting bot. Supports Mac, Windows, and iOS apps. Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and other meeting apps. Audio is transcribed on-device and deleted immediately; only transcript and notes persist. No browser plugin or private deployment documented.

data_policy.value: By default, Granola may use anonymized data to improve services, never sent to third parties for training. Users can opt out of model training in Settings > Preferences. Third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) are contractually prohibited from training on user data. Enterprise has org-wide AI training opt-out by default.

positioning.value: Capture notes your way – bot or no bot – so you can stay focused on the meeting; AI summaries instantly available after your call; Whether you’re a team of 1 or 1,000, Fathom’s got your back.

target_user.value: Fathom is best suited for individuals, sales teams, marketing teams, customer success teams, leadership teams, project teams, remote teams, operations teams, and organizations that need AI meeting notes...

core_capability.value: Capture notes your way – bot or no bot; AI summaries instantly available after your call; Your meeting data, now inside ChatGPT, Claude, and more; Automatically monitor key topics so you never miss critical moments.

free_tier.value: Unlimited recordings & storage; Unlimited transcriptions in 38 languages; Advanced summaries for your first 5 calls each month (after that, only the General/Enhanced template will be available); CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close) for up to 3 users per email domain, personal-use Zapier integration; Standard experience, no customizations.

rejected.value: Fathom costs $19 to $34 per user monthly as of July 16, 2026. Premium is $20/user/mo ($16 annual) for individuals. Team runs $19 ($15 annual, 2-user minimum) and Business $34 ($25 annual, 2-user minimum). Enterprise is quote-only.

price_model.value: For our new plans (Team and Business), free seats are no longer available. All free users will need to upgrade to a paid seat to continue using Fathom. This means their account will count toward your plan's paid seat total going forward. All Admins are considered Paid Users.

key_limit.value: Advanced summaries for your first 5 calls each month (after that, only the General/Enhanced template will be available); CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close) for up to 3 users per email domain; Standard experience, no customizations.

deployment.value: Use this section as a quick way to audit that you've installed our Desktop App, Zoom App, and/or Chrome Extension.

data_policy.value: Fathom may use de-identified customer data to improve our proprietary AI models, and you can opt out at any time. Visit our Trust Center for more information.
